faqs.question: What facilities are there at Graduate School of Business in terms of infrastructure?
faqs.answer: Graduate School of Business has been rated 5 on Infrastructure parameter. Graduate School of Business provide good facilities all around the campus such as Auditorium, Cafeteria, Gym, Hospital / Medical Facilities, Hostel, Labs, Library, Sports Complex, Wi-Fi Campus. Graduate School of Business has also been rated 4.5 for Campuslife.

faqs.question: Which courses does Graduate School of Business offer to students?
faqs.answer: Graduate School of Business has courses such as BBA, BCA, B.Com, MBA/PGDM to offer. These courses are in the stream of Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Accounting & Commerce.

faqs.question: How can I get into Graduate School of Business for UG/PG courses? Am I eligible for admission?
faqs.answer:
Graduate School of Business has below criteria for taking admissions to it's various courses:
Courses Eligibility
BBA Candidate must have passed 10+2 in any stream from a recognised educational board. Candidate appeared for 10+2 exam and is waiting for the result can also apply.
BCA Candidate must have passed 10+2 exam in any stream from a recognised board/ council.
B.Com Candidate must have passed 10+2 with some compulsory subjects including Accountancy, Business Studies, Maths/optional subject, and/ or Economics.

faqs.question: How much is the intake across all courses being offerred at Graduate School of Business?
faqs.answer: The overall seats available across all courses offered by Graduate School of Business is up to 660. Good thing to know is that Graduate School of Business has courses which are approved by prominent Government bodies like AICTE.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Overall a good college but faculty should be more helpful.

review_content.Placements: In every class, there are 25 to 30 students, and if we talk about MBA courses, then there will be 20 to 25 students present in the class. The average college placement offer is 6-7 lakhs/annum. At GSB, there are plenty of top companies like Bajaj Finserv Pvt. Ltd, and Teleperformance. Almost 85% of students at GSB will surely get internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: At the GSB campus, students can take advantage of smart classrooms with AC facilities, science labs, arts & crafts classrooms, a library, and an auditorium. Fashion Designing courses are available in college, and some big events are also planned for students.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: The best 3 years of your life that you'll never forget Overall I will rate GSB 9 out of 10.

review_content.Placements: The placement percentage would be 70%. There were so many companies like TCL ,Deloitte, Teleperformance etc who come to college and placement most likely depends on students, how they score in interview and amplitude. The maximum package was 15 LPA and minimum was 4 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: GSB is a private college. So the facilities provided by the college were top notch. The classroom are all Ac ventilated. The campus was open and have a nice spacious playground and garden. There were lift facility, water cooler , clean washrooms and very huge library area too. Even some teachers are that much friendly. They laughed with you and support you in study.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: The college faculty is very good and the crowd makes it more relevant.

review_content.Placements: Half of the students got placed. The lowest package was 2 lacs and the highest was 5 lacs. The college provides internships in the college itself. But that is only for students in their first year or second year, and only 10-20 students are selected.
review_content.Infrastructure: The faculty is very good and very supportive. The faculty understands the problems of the students and tries to sort them off. There are labs in the college, like the biolab and chemistry lab, with Wi-Fi facilities available. There is a canteen, and the quality of the food is really good.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Graduate School of Business.

review_content.Placements: Our college has provided good placement opportunities to us. Many companies visit our college for recruiting students. Around 40% to 45% of students were placed in the previous year with attractive salary packages. The lowest salary package offered is 2.5 LPA, and the average salary package offered is 5.5 LPA to 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Wipro, Tata Motors, Bajaj, IBM, HDFC Bank, Young, Accenture, Capgemini, Nestle, Velnik, Wockhardt Ltd., Zydus Cadila Ltd. Around 40% to 50% of students got internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has provided us sports and games facilities with proper guidance and proper kits. Many students take part in various sports and games and perform well. Our classrooms are also furnished with tables, chairs, eclectic supply, smart boards with projectors. There is a library where books can be borrowed with a library card. There is hostel facility with proper beds, chairs, tables, wardrobes, and mess facility. Bus facility is also available for students. A canteen is also available in our college. Medical kits and fire extinguishers are also available. Wi-Fi setup is all over the campus. An auditorium is also there for college events and seminars.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: College with Good academics and helpful faculty members.

review_content.Placements: Almost 25% to 35% of students get placed in many good companies in recruitment drives. The lowest salary package offered is 2 LPA and the highest salary package offered is 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Tata Consultancy Services, HDFC Bank, Young, Mahindra, Zydus Cadila Limited, etc. Almost 50% of the students got internships in many companies visiting the college. Top courses offered in our college were MBA, BBA, BCA, B.Com, B.A., and other PG and certification courses.
review_content.Infrastructure: In college, there is a big, well-stocked library with many collections of books, magazines, newspapers, and journals available. Students prepare for exams and competitive exams from the library by borrowing books. There are fully air-conditioned computer labs. Sports and games facilities are available. There is an auditorium where many cultural programs and events are held. Medical facilities and first aid kits are available. A cafeteria is also available. Our classrooms are well-maintained properly.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Graduate School of Business.

review_content.Placements: Around 30% to 40% of the students get placed in many companies during the placement drive. The average salary package offered is 4 LPA. Some of the companies that visited for recruitment were TCS, SBI Wockhardt Ltd., Wipro, Infosys, etc. Around 50% of students got internships in various companies. The top job roles offered in this course are Sales Analyst, Accountant, Tax Advisory, Manager, and Sales Executive.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has well-furnished classrooms with proper furniture, lights, fans, and smart boards. The classrooms are very spacious with good ventilation. There is a library with a wide range of books. Laboratory facilities are also available. Our college provides medical facilities and has a sports complex. The canteen offers good food options. Wi-Fi setups are also available across the college campus.

individual_reviews.title: It is really good with great learning opportunities.

content.Placements: Good in academics and good communication skills is required to get placed. Also many companies come at the time of placement and recruit many of the eligible students for their bright future.
content.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure, classes are like auditorium with learning. The departments are BBA department, MBA department, pharmacy department. Good sports infrastructure is there also it motivates students to be the best in fitness. The faculty also encourages students.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Lotus Institute Of Management is not bad, but it can be good.

content.Placements: Approximately 1,000 got placed. The highest salary offered is Rs. 25,000 per month, the average salary offered is Rs. 15,000 per month and the lowest salary offered is Rs. 8,000 per month. Many companies visited our college for recruitment. In our course, the salary package offered is only 2.64 LPA but not above. Many companies offered an internship for students.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is not available in our college. Labs are average, and classrooms are not bad. The library is good. In summers, classrooms are very bad because air-conditioner is not working and fans give hot air. Our college does not have a hostel, so there is no food and no facilities.

college_info.intro:
Sikkim Professional University has a great impact in the fields of BSc, MSc and BTech, making them a part of the popular programmes. Sikkim Professional University offers 3 years of specialisation in BSc and 2 years of specialisation in MSc. It offers a BSc or MSc in Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biotechnology, Environment and Ecology, and IT. The eligibility criteria for a BSc course contain 50% marks in Class 12 with PCM or PCB along with other set of eligibility criteria set by the University. For an MSc, candidates must secure a minimum of 50% marks in the same specialisation as of BSc.
Apart from this, the University offers 4 years for any specialisation in BTech and 2 years of course length for any specialisation in MTech. It offers a BTech/ MTech / 3-year diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and CS Engineering. Candidates must qualify 10+2 in PCM with 50% aggregate for admission in any specialisation of BTech. For admission to MTech, candidates must secure 50% aggregate in BE/BTech, to be eligible for admission to any specialisation. Apart from the aggregate marks, the eligibility criteria may contain other set of eligibility requirements as per the University.

overview_faqs.question: Is a Bachelor of Ophthalmic Technology available at Sikkim Professional University?
overview_faqs.answer: Sikkim Professional University offers a Diploma as well as a Bachelor of Ophthalmic Technology within the vocational subjects of Paramedical. The University offers a 3-year course with the eligibility criteria of PCB/PCM in Class 12. Apart from this course, Sikkim Professional University’s vocational course department offers Bachelor's and Diploma in specialisations such as Operation Theatre Technology, Radiology and Medical Imaging Technology, Dialysis Therapy and Lab Technology.

overview_faqs.question: Is Sikkim Professional University real?
overview_faqs.answer: Sikkim Professional University was established in the year 2008 under the name of Vinayaka Missions Sikkim University, on a 5-acre land. It was later named as Sikkim Professional University and much later earned recognition by the UGC. It has recognition of several other institutional bodies such as AIU, INC, BCI, PCI and SNC. The University ranks 54 as per the India Today rankings of 2024 in the Govt/Pvt universities category. Apart from this, the University offers more than 50 specialisations through 13 department colleges and 100+ faculty.

review_summary.college_name: Sikkim Professional University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Education - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the best faculties as well as the infrastructure and the surroundings.

content.Placements: Almost 60-75 percent of students got placed from my course. The highest package offered in my course is up to 2 LPA, and the lowest is up to Rs. 80,000, and the average is up to 1.2 LPA. Top companies recruit from tech giants, including Microsoft, Google, BCG, etc. 65 percent of students got internships from my course and in top companies like BCG, Google, etc. Top roles offered include graphic designer and ui/ux designer.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities like free Wi-Fi access, classrooms, labs, etc., are available, as well as great infrastructure facilities of canteens, computer labs, and libraries. The quality of facilities is great in my hostel, as the quality of food is also good because they maintain hygiene plus provide diverse dishes, as well as sports and games.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in General Study - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: There are almost 200-300 students placed in my course. The highest package here is up to 10 LPA, and the lowest is 2 LPA. I don't know about the percentage of students placed, but a good amount of students got good placement. My course has some selective roles.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities provided in our college are quite good. There is everything like Wi-Fi, labs, a library, a laboratory, etc. The facilities provided in the hostel are also quite good, but the quality of food in the mess is not that good. Although, the other facilities are good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty and promising Pharma placements.

content.Placements: Around 60% students were placed. The highest package offered was 10 LPA, while the lowest was around 2LPA. The recruiting companies were Cipla Limited and Aristo. Almost 90% students got internship at the STNM hospital. The roles offered were Pharmacy Technician and Production Executive.
content.Infrastructure: The B.Pharma department at SPU has modern labs for all the core pharmacy subjects, Wi-Fi enabled classrooms, and a well stocked library. Hostels were clean with decent mess food, a canteen, basic medical care, and facilities for both indoor and outdoor sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Good college with good teachers.

content.Placements: In every batch, there are a total of 30 seats. Our seniors get a package of Rs 20,000 to Rs 40,000 salary package. From our course, companies like Opolo reach out to students and internships. We get to go to clinics in government hospitals which provide us a clear view of what we have to do in situations that need emergency treatment.
content.Infrastructure: We have a library and every little facility. But there is a water problem in winter like we get water at a certain time in winter. But in summer, we get 24X7 water. The seniors here are also so helpful and just like friends. We get our own rooms at the hostel. Hostel food is also tasty.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Education - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: An honest review of my college, in my personal opinion.

content.Placements: About 36-37% of students were placed in my course. The highest package offered was 15-18 LPA. The minimum was 3-4 LPA. Several companies, like Axon, Rodics, etc., were recruited in our course. Honestly, I didn’t know much about it. About 25-27% of students, including me, got internships from my college.
content.Infrastructure: Everything was available in my college, like Wi-Fi, labs, laboratories, library, and well-maintained classrooms. Facilities and infrastructure in our college were really good. The quality of food in our mess was quite acceptable and edible. Hostel facilities were average, not so good. Medical and sports facilities were provided in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the best faculties as well as the infrastructure and the surroundings.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like free Wi-Fi access, classrooms, labs, etc., are available, as well as great infrastructure facilities of canteens, computer labs, and libraries. The quality of facilities is great in my hostel, as the quality of food is also good because they maintain hygiene plus provide diverse dishes, as well as sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities provided in our college are quite good. There is everything like Wi-Fi, labs, a library, a laboratory, etc. The facilities provided in the hostel are also quite good, but the quality of food in the mess is not that good. Although, the other facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty and promising Pharma placements.
reviews.review_text: The B.Pharma department at SPU has modern labs for all the core pharmacy subjects, Wi-Fi enabled classrooms, and a well stocked library. Hostels were clean with decent mess food, a canteen, basic medical care, and facilities for both indoor and outdoor sports.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with good teachers.
reviews.review_text: We have a library and every little facility. But there is a water problem in winter like we get water at a certain time in winter. But in summer, we get 24X7 water. The seniors here are also so helpful and just like friends. We get our own rooms at the hostel. Hostel food is also tasty.

reviews.review_heading: An honest review of my college, in my personal opinion.
reviews.review_text: Everything was available in my college, like Wi-Fi, labs, laboratories, library, and well-maintained classrooms. Facilities and infrastructure in our college were really good. The quality of food in our mess was quite acceptable and edible. Hostel facilities were average, not so good. Medical and sports facilities were provided in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty as well as good placement and environment too.
reviews.review_text: Many great facilities and infrastructure are available, like free Wi-Fi, fully AC classrooms, and many labs. The quality of facilities available in the hostel was also very good, as the food was totally hygienic. Many canteens are also there, and a few sports and games playing grounds are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computer Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Best college in our district, but placement is poor. The building and environment are above average.

content.Placements: Placement of this college is below average because no company prefers this college at first. As maximum students are from village areas, most students are less careful about their studies. But some teachers are very careful about us. We hope that placements will increase in the next few years.
content.Infrastructure: Campus is average, but working on new buildings, which is very good. They use smart boards. They use air conditioning. They use lifts as the building has many floors. I love the new building. Everyone is excited for the new building, including me and all my friends.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com in Accountancy - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: It is a great course and everything is awesome.

content.Placements: About 77% of students get placed in our course. In B.Com in Accountancy honors, a salary of Rs. 20,000 per month is offered for all over 3 years. CA funds companies are the top recruiting companies of our course. It is a normal course so here no internship is provided. Accounting is the top role offered in this course.
content.Infrastructure: Department and hostels are so helpful even customised. Students can enjoy free Wi-Fi and the library is very good. Students can find any books here that they want. Sports, games, medical and canteen food, everything is available here. Everything available is very good at the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in Economics - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: A midrange university and good for home university. Good travel and rent on campus.

content.Placements: Raiganj University B.Sc. (Hons.) in Economics is a 3-year (Now 4th year) course offered at the UG level. To be eligible for this course, students must have 60.0% in 12th. The total tuition fee for B.Sc. (Hons.) in Economics at Raiganj University is INR 1871 (including semester feels and others charge). No additional fees charged. This course admits 70 students. Discover other available courses under B.A. at Raiganj University.
content.Infrastructure: Raiganj University's infrastructure is also good. Raiganj University has two hostels on campus, separate for girls and boys, with 60+60 seats. The meal charge is 1000, and for two semesters 4500 admission feels. Criteria are only distance & marks. Raiganj University professors are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Mathematics - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of my university.

content.Placements: The placement rate for students in my course is quite low, and it is not considered a good value for money. On average, the package offered to students in this course is only 15k. There are no companies actively recruiting from this course. However, around 10 percent of students are able to secure internships easily. In general, many students end up pursuing careers as teachers.
content.Infrastructure: The department I belong to is mathematics, which is equipped with specialized classrooms. It provides its students and teachers with their own Wi-Fi network. Although the department itself does not have a dedicated library, the university offers a vast library that caters to the needs of students from all departments.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in Education - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: A good university in Raiganj.

content.Placements: In Raiganj University, they can't provide many placement opportunities. They only offer placements in BCA and B.Sc. Computer Science fields. As far as I know, companies like TCS, Amazon, etc. , visit our college. Approximately 20-30% of students secure internships because the competition is too high.
content.Infrastructure: In Raiganj University, they provide us with a vast library, large computer labs, spacious classrooms, seminar rooms, Wi-Fi hostels, and almost everything that a student needs. Hostel facilities at our university are above average, with two large hostel rooms and Wi-Fi facilities. The food quality is good. Sports such as cricket, football, and NCC-type games are provided in our university.

admission_process.title: Raiganj University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Raiganj University admission process 2025ismerit-based. The university hasthree institutes affiliatedwith it, that offer general and honours degree courses at UG and PG levels. The affiliated institutes areEastern Institute for Integrated Learning in Management (EIILM),Gourav Institute of Management Science,andDurapur Women’s College (DWC).Further, the university offers courses in two modes:Aided and Self-financed.Raiganj University'sself-financed pragrammes run in the evening shifts.

Themerit listfor self-financing courses is prepared separately. All the eligible candidates have to apply separately for the self-financed programmes. The university offers admission based on the merit obtained in the qualifying exam,except the MBA programmefor which the entrance test score is taken into consideration.

The eligibility criteria for both aided and self-financed programmes are the same. Candidates appearing in the final year of the qualifying examination are also eligible to apply toRaiganj courses. However, they are required to submit a passed mark sheet before the final admission.Englishis amandatorysubject for admission to any UG course at Raiganj University. faqs.answer: The Placements at the Raiganj University have seen a significant decrease in the placement rates. reviews.review_text: Campus is average, but working on new buildings, which is very good. They use smart boards. They use air conditioning. They use lifts as the building has many floors. I love the new building. Everyone is excited for the new building, including me and all my friends.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great course and everything is awesome.
reviews.review_text: Department and hostels are so helpful even customised. Students can enjoy free Wi-Fi and the library is very good. Students can find any books here that they want. Sports, games, medical and canteen food, everything is available here. Everything available is very good at the college.

reviews.review_heading: A midrange university and good for home university. Good travel and rent on campus.
reviews.review_text: Raiganj University's infrastructure is also good. Raiganj University has two hostels on campus, separate for girls and boys, with 60+60 seats. The meal charge is 1000, and for two semesters 4500 admission feels. Criteria are only distance & marks. Raiganj University professors are good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my university.
reviews.review_text: The department I belong to is mathematics, which is equipped with specialized classrooms. It provides its students and teachers with their own Wi-Fi network. Although the department itself does not have a dedicated library, the university offers a vast library that caters to the needs of students from all departments.

reviews.review_heading: A good university in Raiganj.
reviews.review_text: In Raiganj University, they provide us with a vast library, large computer labs, spacious classrooms, seminar rooms, Wi-Fi hostels, and almost everything that a student needs. Hostel facilities at our university are above average, with two large hostel rooms and Wi-Fi facilities. The food quality is good. Sports such as cricket, football, and NCC-type games are provided in our university.

reviews.review_heading: Best University in Raiganj, West Bengal.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a huge seminar room, three big computer labs, a projector in every room, and every department has Wi-Fi facilities. Hostels are good, and Wi-Fi facilities also have their. Food quality is good in a mess. Our college has organized many sports like cricket, football, and NCC-type extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: Pros and Cons of Raiganj University.
reviews.review_text: They have a library where you can access a wide range of books related to your courses. Classrooms are spacious Some classrooms have projector with Wi-Fi available. They have Laboratory for practical subjects. Toilets are clean and hygienic. Additional, there is a hostel facility available for eligible students.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good University according to placement but dissatisfied of faculty.
reviews.review_text: Our college hostels are very good, all time electricity and free Wi-Fi always available, most of all that 24 h uninterrupted water supply provided here at low cost. Classrooms are okay with new technologies and in lab all safety are taken when deals with chemicals. About the library it is very good course relates all books are available here.

reviews.review_heading: Good to go New 10 storey building is coming.
reviews.review_text: Fully digital classrooms are available in our college and infrastructure is well developed with cctv solar panel to save electricity as well. I don't know about hostel but I heard food and all are good. So if u live far away from college u can choose hostel as well.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty and else everything was fine and well. The Curriculum and exams.
reviews.review_text: Course facilities are well but don't have any idea about the hostel. Wi-Fi is there but not in all the courses and labs are properly working for the Science subjects. Regarding the hostel, I really don't have any idea, because I didn't stay there but from outside, it looks well maintained, neat and clean.

reviews.review_heading: It is a well-maintained university.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is far better than that of other colleges in our area. We have clean classrooms with all facilities needed for students and professors to interact. Trees are planted, and we will have a 10-storied building soon.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is the best place for learning and for future opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The university has a decorated, clean and green campus. The university is fully free Wi-Fi zone and has a central library where anyone can find books of local and foreign authors. The university has an equipment based labs, digital classrooms, clean canteen, good hostel rooms and students’ health care unit. Annual sports meet also creates amusement in students and all teaching and non-teaching staff.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this stream in Raiganj University, and this is really a good decision for me.
reviews.review_text: All the computers in the lab are in working condition. Our department provides free Wi-Fi. The classrooms are in good condition. The hostel quality is really good. The quality of food is good. The quality of sports and medical facilities is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Quite satisfied with the overall facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure provided are good. Free Wi-Fi is available and the classrooms are quite nice. During an emergency, medical facilities are provided by the university. Due to covid, canteen facility is still not provided.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, great campus.
reviews.review_text: Airy classrooms, audio visual classes, interactive lectures is the key features. Huge auditorium for seminars. Hostels with great facilities. We had excellent amenities in our classrooms, labs, libraries, sports facilities, and hostels, making the overall experience preety positive. The wi-fi facility was up to date and with excellent connectivity.

content.Infrastructure: I want to inform all candidates or people who are going to read this that the interior of this college is very bad. The desks, benches, and blackboards in the classrooms are not tidy or clean, and many of them are broken. The fans do not work properly, and the windows of the classrooms are also broken and rusty.

content.Placements: In this new AI era placement is getting tougher as fewer companies are visiting the college and also the competition is very high nowadays but you will get ample opportunities over here. reviews.review_heading: Good placements in 2021.

reviews.review_heading: It provided good placements in 2021.

reviews.review_heading: In all total, I am satisfied with my college life.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available for our course are very good. The classrooms are well arranged, and the location of the college is also in very good place. reviews.review_text: Classrooms are spacious and can accommodate around 60 students. The campus has Wi-Fi. The labs are not excellent but are above average. The library is good, with a wide variety of books available. The interior design of the hostel is nice, and the food is also quite good.

reviews.review_heading: If you want only a degree, you will definitely take admission.
reviews.review_text: In my department, the basic facilities like classrooms, labs, and Wi-Fi are available, though not at the level of top colleges. Classrooms are spacious but could use more modern equipment. Labs are functional with the necessary instruments and computers, but sometimes lack the latest upgrades. The library has a decent collection of books and study materials, along with a digital section for reference.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in the Ramgarh area.
reviews.review_text: The hostel mess and canteen provide the best food for students, and medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: If you want only a degree this is a good choice but if you want skills you have to look at another.
reviews.review_text: The college provides Wi-Fi, laboratories, classrooms, a library, and hostels. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is satisfactory. Medical facilities are also available, and there are sports and games offered on campus. The college is green, beautiful, and clean, although the toilets are below average. There is a swimming pool, and buildings are well-maintained, though the college is undergoing further construction.

reviews.review_heading: I want to write this review because I want to share the information about my college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of our course are good. Wi-Fi is not so good in our classrooms. But the lab is not so good as per fee structure. reviews.review_heading: This college is the best college to complete your graduation.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It has a mesmerizing environment.

content.Placements: 20% of students get placed in our course. The highest package offered in our college is 8 LPA. The average package is 6 LPA and the lowest package is 4 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are Infosys BPM, TVS, Titan, and Adenza. 10% of students got internships from our course in Chennai state companies. NCC and Navy guidance are offered in our course.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides Wi-Fi, labs, libraries, supportive mentors, and classrooms. The food quality in the canteen and mess is good and hygienic. It offers both veg and non-veg food. Coffee, tea, and all things are also available. Sitting arrangements for both girls and boys are separate. According to need, we can take food. It also provides games like cricket and football.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It's good for explanation on study-based, but not campus-based, and no one comes for placement.

content.Placements: No company comes for placement. The college is good for everything, but the important is placement. This is why I'm not recommending anyone based on placement. Based on my experience, it is not good for our batch, but we are serious about getting some students placed. No one comes here.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is also good, based on living conditions. All the facilities are in the hostel, like a hospital, ladies' attendants, security guards, and every facility is there in both the college and the hostel.
content.Faculty: The college is very good for completing the syllabus. The exams are conducted very strictly. In one hall, there are 2 teachers, and 2 times checking is compulsory. If anyone brings chits or anything, they will be debarred, and their paper will be marked as a fail. Some teachers do not debar students if the examiner observes that the student should be debarred compulsorily.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college is good, and in the end, what really matters is students' hard work.

content.Placements: Toppers and students with skills get placed in reputed companies. Average students with good skills also get placed in good companies so what matters is students' ability. Overall, placements are good in numbers.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. It has smart boards, which make it easy to understand the higher technical terms. Our labs are good and are being updated now with Windows 11 PCs. Our college has a library with so many books and PCs for use in college-related stuff.
content.Faculty: Exams here are conducted by VTU University Belgaum and are conducted very strictly. Results are provided within 10 days after exams. Our teachers are well-experienced and guide us to score well. Many students score well with hard work.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: GNDEC - Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College.

content.Placements: Placements in our college are very poor. Due to the lack of top companies in our city, no companies visit our college because it is far away from Bangalore. In our college, what lectures teach is not enough to get placements. Around 50% of students got placed. Students should search for placements by themselves.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very good. It is the biggest college in our city. It contains many branches. All facilities are good. The lab is good. Our college has a ground, an auditorium, and a garden.
content.Faculty: Our college is under VTU, so exams are conducted according to its rules and dates. Faculty members are not good at teaching. Some of them are good but not all. There are many courses in our college like computer science and engineering, information science, and electrical and electronics engineering. Most of the lectures belong to the Singh caste.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good institute for pursuing your degree in BIDAR !

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the best college for the MBA course.

content.Placements: More than 80 percent of MBA students get internships and job placements. Leading corporations, like Birla, Tata, and Adani, routinely hire on campus. I believe that my college is a fantastic choice for kids from lower and middle-class families. The average pay is 10 LPA, and top positions offered include HR Manager, Investment Banker, and others.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure includes well-equipped modern buildings appropriate for all levels, as well as skilled instructors and a classroom setting. The library contains a wide range of maritime literature and academic textbooks. In the evening, we can use the basketball and football grounds, which may not exceed the high standards required in northern India; however, the canteen serves reasonable and good meals to all. Basketball, soccer, and volleyball are all part of the daily activities.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Faculty members and infrastructure are outstanding, and the placement record is also good.

content.Placements: Our college’s placement record is always around 60 percent, but the teaching methods here are very helpful in the outside world. The college provides special facilities to students through various practicals and projects. Our students get placements in big companies like Wipro, Mahindra, Tata, and Amazon. The salary offered from our campus is around 7 to 8 LPA. Students here are appointed to good positions like management consultants in various companies.
content.Infrastructure: Our college is quite big and full of plants. Every classroom has air conditioning and projector facilities. Apart from that, for the convenience of students, there is a café area, gym centre, playing field, and a new campus Wi-Fi facility. We have a big library on our campus which has different types of books. The hostel faculty here is also very helpful and good.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: The college does no provide placements, which is one kind of dissatisfaction.

content.Placements: About 50-60% of the students in our course got placed. Salary is not offered in our course. For the financial analyst, there are no placements in our academic year, but their position outside will be high. Placements for MBA and pharmacy are conducted in one place. admission_process.title: Maharishi Arvind University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Maharishi Arvind University admission 2025 is open.The university offers numerous UG, PG, diploma, and PhD courses, These courses are offered in the fields of Agricultural Science, Law, Computer Science & Informatics, Commerce, Education, and Physiotherapy Commonly known asMAUJ, the university accepts students on both entrance and merit basis depending on the programme chosen. Interested students can read the following article to know about the courses, eligibility, selection criteria, and admission procedure for Maharishi Arvind University.

Maharishi Arvind University course admissionis subject to fulfilment of the course-specific admission criteria as per the university's guidelines. Students are shortlisted based on several parameters, including entrance exam scores (if applicable) and academic merit. The university provides an extensive range of courses thorough its departments. Students can check out the table below to learn about the eligibility and selection criteria for some of the popularMaharishi Arvind University courses:

The admission procedure for Maharishi Arvind University involves several steps, such as application, selection, appearing for the entrance exam (if applicable), and admission confirmation, Students must fulfil the eligibility criteria of the desired programme before proceeding further. Eligible students can follow the step-wiseMAUJ admission processmentioned below:
Step 1; MAUJ Application Process 2025

Interested students can visit the official website of the university and click on the "Apply Now" button to fill out the enquiry form. Alternatively, students can also download the course-wise application form available and submit the duly filled-in form to the University City office along with the demand draft drawn in favour of MAUJ.
Step 2; MAUJ Selection Process 2025

The university shortlists candidates based on various parameters. Maharishi Arvind University's selection process differs on the basis of course wise. For MBA admissions, the university accepts a valid CAT score, while for law courses, students need to appear for the MUALET exam conducted by the university. For the remaining programmes, candidates are selected on the basis of merit in the qualifying exams.
Step 3: MAUJ Admission Confirmation

Selected candidates will be given the Offer of Admission letters by either email or post. The merit list is also displayed on the university's official website. Students need to report to the university with the offer letter and required documents for verification. Post the verification, seats will be allotted once the candidates pay the admission fees.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement. Really good.
reviews.review_text: College provides excellent sports facilities a medical center a library Wi-Fi classrooms and hostels. The canteen offers food and the labs have modern infrastructure available for all departments. Sports and games are well-organised and the medical center ensures health services for students.

reviews.review_heading: The truth of Maharshi Arvind University .
reviews.review_text: Actually this is the best part of our university, the infrastructure, the design and the amount of money they had  used in the infrastructure of the university. University doesn't have Wi-Fi connectivity for the students nor in the library. Even mobile phones are not allowed in the University's library. University has an auditorium, a cricket ground etc.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is not available. A mess and canteen are available. The quality of food in the canteen is good and affordable. Labs are available and well-maintained. A library is available. Wi-Fi is not available.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of the infrastructure, faculty members, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. The best and most peaceful environment is the library because it's too quiet to study. Our classrooms are too good. Our laboratories are bright and well-ventilated. There is no hostel, but PG services are available within 500 meters.

reviews.review_heading: Our university is good for better education.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. A huge library is available for students. Our classrooms are in good condition. The sports culture is not good in our college.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best private universities in Jaipur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is basically spread in a vast area. It has an eco-friendly zone with many sports facilities and other academic activities. It also has facilities like computer labs, science labs, etc. It is mainly connected with the main Sirsi road Jaipur. It has a personal library so that students don't need to buy books from outside.

reviews.review_heading: There is good infrastructure and surroundings.
reviews.review_text: Labs are available in our university. There are different labs for all students according to their course. The library is available in the university with a good environment. There is a canteen in the university. The food served is good like normal drinks and snacks. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty members but placements are not good.
reviews.review_text: Lab are well equipped, and all the instruments are available. Wi-Fi facility is not appropriate, library and classroom are well-maintained. Smart classes are also available for students. Canteen food is not good as I expected but mess food is good as compared to the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied because of faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: There are no hostel facilities. Our university has its own library and canteen, and free Wi-Fi is also available. Classrooms have good furniture and all essential things. Our university has basketball ground, cricket ground and indoor games ground also.

reviews.review_heading: The college has a good infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our course is very good. There are smart classrooms with a projector setup. The furniture of the classrooms is very good, and there is a library on every floor with books related to every course. The atmosphere of the library is very calm. However, the college has no hostel.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is good. Courses are available, but the drawback is there are no placements.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available on our campus. Wi-Fi is available, but they don't provide a password. Labs are available, and the classrooms are good. There is also a library, where lots of books are available for reading/learning. Every year a sports week is organised by the university on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities are not so good, and the course can also be better.
reviews.review_text: Our college has very weak Wi-Fi, and it's protected with a password. Neither they give the password to use, nor they open it for college time. Facilities are not provided in our college, and no one wants to study here. There is a small canteen which will always be closed.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good with good faculty. The issues here will be resolved shortly.
reviews.review_text: There are lots of issues related to the infrastructure. The college doesn't provide any sports facility, and even the washrooms are not properly cleaned and maintained well. However, our classrooms are good, and the labs are well maintained and equipped with good machines. Our canteen is good, and the quality of the food offered in the canteen is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Students can choose this college if they want to go for agriculture branch.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is moderate in the college. It is neither good, nor too bad. Labs are well equipped. Wi-Fi and washrooms are not in good condition. There is no proper arrangement for sports and games. Only a cricket ground is available for the students.

reviews.review_heading: The college has learning empowerment.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good infrastructure with natural air-conditioning. There is no Wi-Fi available on the campus because it focuses only on studies. The library is pretty big where students can spend their time with friends. The ayurvedic faculty team is available in the next building where medical and research labs are also available.

review_summary.college_name: Harda Degree College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. in Taxation - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: One of the good colleges in Harda, it provides various opportunities to students.

content.Placements: It usually does not provide various placement opportunities. There were many students. Various banks come for placement. Recently Axis bank placement was done. But the placement percentage is low here. In our course, around 200 students were there.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good but there is no hostel facility available. There are various labs for practicals and a big library. Classrooms are also well-maintained. There's a canteen also but they sell packed food. Medical facilities are also provided.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Not given much preference to placements, but good to join.

content.Placements: About 35% of students have chosen the BBA course, it is a very demanding course in my college. The lowest package was 15000rs/month and the highest was 30000, the average was approximately 18000-20000 only. The top recruiting companies were: HDFC, ICICI, Modicare. About 35% of students got internships the previous year in medicare, Godrej, organic harvest, etc. The top roles that are offered are HR manager, marketing manager, and financial manager.
content.Infrastructure: A big classroom was available but lack of fans, a water purifier, a library, playground for different games like table tennis, badminton, volleyball, chess, etc. Medium-size parking facility and a conference hall with a stage, and projector room for some kind of presentation.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Our college is one of the prestigious college.

content.Placements: Students placed are very low. Most are going for their Master's. The salary package will be around 3 LPA. Recruiters are Axis bank and HDFC bank. Half of the strength is doing internships because most students have businesses or agricultural land.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is so good with a library, Wi-Fi, labs, and separate classrooms. There is no hostel because the most student is day scholars some are coming from around 20 to 30 km. They use convenient public transport.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Computer Science - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: I am dissatisfied with the placement cell.

content.Placements: There are no proper placements.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very poor. There were no such facilities for hostel and canteen. It was just a simple institute. It was good to be a part of the college, but I always recommend not to take admission in this college.
content.Faculty: The course was good, but we can't guarantee placements because they don't follow any campus selection process. Students have to learn and make their own career on their own. Teachers were helpful and simple. They were knowledgeable, and they were good on their subject.

overview_faqs.question: Is GCT - Gnanamani College of Technology a good college/Institute?
overview_faqs.answer: GCT - Gnanamani College of Technology is a well-known institution for B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, MCA courses. These programs are delivered by highly experienced faculty. As per Shiksha's verified reviews, GCT - Gnanamani College of Technology has a rating of 3.81 on the basis of Shiksha-verified reviews by students. Not just this, it has also been rated 3.72 on Campus Life, 3.56 on Placements, 4 on Faculty and 4.09 on Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: GCT - Gnanamani College of Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Gnanamani College of Technology is a really good engineering college.

content.Placements: Gnanamani College of Technology is a good placement college, with around 90-95% of students placed in good companies in 2021. This college's placement training team brought more reputed companies like TCS, Wipro, Amazon, Yamaha, Hyundai, Tech Mahindra, OLA, TVS, etc., for campus interviews. Placed students' salary packages are INR 2 - 9 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Gnanamani College of Technology's infrastructure facilities are very good. More than 15 courses are available in this college, with good classrooms, hi-tech laboratories, and well-stocked library facilities. This college has 3 hostels, and there is a separate girls' hostel. The hostel food is also good. Some limited sports ground facilities are also available in this college.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and faculty members teaching are so good for our studies.

content.Placements: Our college has good placements. Almost 50% of students got placed in the previous year. The highest salary package offered is INR 5 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is INR 3 LPA. The average salary of INR 2.5 LPA is offered by top recruiting companies like Tech Mahindra, TCS, etc.
content.Infrastructure: There is electricity provided in the hostel, and the beds are good to moderate. Bathroom facilities are there, and the meal is good or not too bad. Registration for the hostel is easy; you have to fill out a form. Computer labs are working properly. There is only a small canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Really good placement and infrastructure.

content.Placements: The highest package is INR 12 lacs, and the minimum package is INR 3 lacs per annum. The top recruiting companies are TCS, Infosys, etc. 70 percent of students got internships. Our college infrastructure is good. I will always be thankful to the faculty and the college.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library facilities are available, as are good food quality. That is one of the basic amenities at the college. The entire college is Wi-Fi-enabled. There is a sports room that has all the possible indoor games, and there is also a gym. We have a cafeteria too.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It has nice infrastructure and good teaching facilities .

content.Placements: In this college, they provide placement for eligible students at the maximum package in companies like TCS, Hexaware, Maventic, VisAi Lab, etc. We can easily understand, and they provide staff to teach placement training and conduct tests and activities.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has nice infrastructure compared to other nearby colleges, a smoke-free college campus, and weekly cleaning and sanitizing of the classrooms is done. They also provide free network and Wi-Fi connections on the college campus and hostel, which is not bad maintenance.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Good placements and faculty members.

content.Placements: So many companies are coming with minimum INR 6 L per annum packages for this course, and the highest package is INR 12 L per annum. Infosys, TCS, CTS, Hexaware, etc. are the top companies coming to this college. In a software and IT company, we are getting an internship certificate with a 7.5 CGPA.
content.Infrastructure: The library is superb, and there are a lot of books in the library. Canteen is also nice. During lab hours, we learned so many things. Faculty members teach us about not only studies but also career growth. In vacation time, we will go to the placement class at our college.

individual_reviews.title: Overall, my experience is decent here.

content.Placements: The eligibility for the course I am studying is 50% and above percentage in any bachelor's degree. The package depends on the skills, talent, and hard work of students. The starting salary ranges from Rs. 12,000-40,000 per month. Students can also start work from home.
content.Infrastructure: Andheri West campus is average. It has 3 classrooms, 1 hall event room which is converted into 2 classrooms and 1 pantry area, which is small. Wi-Fi is provided.
content.Faculty: Faculty members of this institute are all professionals. They are extremely helpful not just according to the course but will help us build our personality according to the career surroundings. We even learn how to build our own business sitting at home and how the industry works. The difficulty level of exams is average.

individual_reviews.title: I would recommend joining this college.

content.Placements: So far it's been a great experience studying at Pannache INSD.

individual_reviews.title: Our college is very good. Good hospitality is provided by the college authority.

content.Placements: Our college is very good at placement. At least 40 percent and a maximum of 60 percent of students are placed in different companies like TCS and Tech Mahindra, and different multinational companies at a good package of 10 LPA to 16 LPA, so I prefer to come to the college.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides 24-hour high-speed Wi-Fi to us, and various types of labs are provided by the college authority to different departments, like the botany lab, the chemistry lab, the zoology lab, the physics lab, etc. Our college hostel is good, but the food is not so good.

individual_reviews.title: The college is good but the faculty members are not so good.

content.Placements: Placements are not too good and they are average. Most of the pass-out students do not get any placements. It only has a good name and fame but it does not have many facilities. It cannot even give a good job to MBA-passed students.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, but for today's world, it does not match. It has more than 5 buildings but it is not so good. It has 8 galleries, auditorium, fields and a campus which is less than 500 square meters. It is a government college, and it is not so good.

content.Placements: A very high percentage, i.e., more than 75% of students get placed in the top companies in India. content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available in my department are super. Wi-Fi, classrooms, library as well as labs are available for students in the college. review_summary.college_name: Albertian Institute of Management Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Our college is a good option for an MBA in Kochi and has an excellent campus and facilities.

content.Placements: In our college, almost 85% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered was 6 LPA and the average salary package offered was 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies like HDFC Bank, ESAF Bank, India Mart, Bajaj Alliance, etc., visited our campus. Almost 70% of students got internships at Kotak Mahindra Bank and Kantar IMRB. Top roles offered were marketing executive, HR executive, and various sales roles.
content.Infrastructure: Smart classrooms were available. There was a computer lab to ensure computer availability for each student. Wi-Fi was available in both digital and offline libraries. Many books were available in the library. The hostel was neat and clean. Medical facilities were available.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: An insight into the life and education at Albertian Institute of Management.

content.Placements: Placements for both our batch as well as the senior batch was excellent. Around 70% of the students from both the batches were placed in different organizations. More job opportunities were for marketing and HR specializations. Companies like HDFC Securities Ltd., HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Berger Paints etc. recruited students. The salary ranged between 1.5 lakhs per annum to 4.5 lakhs per annum. The highest salary offered was 4.5 lakhs p.a . The roles offered included, relationship officer, personal banker, securities officer, recruitment officers, HR associate etc.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: The college is satisfactory overall, but it doesn't excel in any factor and hence has no USP.

content.Placements: The placements for our batch and our seniors' batch were commendable. Major companies which recruited from our college include Airtel, KPMG, Future Group, Colgate-Palmolive etc. The highest salary was Rs. 3 lac per annum and the lowest was around Rs. 1.8 per annum. The placement were higher for students specializing in Marketing or Finance. Almost 80% of the students were placed in both batches. HR and IT majors did not receive any placement support.
content.Infrastructure: Though the college does not provide hostel facilities or canteen, the location of the institute makes up for this drawback. Situated in the heart of Kochi, it can easily be accessed, and accommodation and food facilities are easy to find. The campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled and new sets of PCs were installed just a few months back. The institute shares a playground with the nearby school, but it is available for the students after class. Sports and athletics competitions are held annually in this ground.

review_summary.college_name: Samata College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Really a good college to join.

content.Placements: My seniors have got a good percentage of 8.5. The highest package in my college for an MBA is 6 LPA and the lowest would be 3.5 LPA. I'm not sure about the recruiters.
content.Infrastructure: We have free Wi-Fi, one computer lab, one laptop lab, one library, and good classrooms with at least two windows and five fans. We also have a canteen with reasonable prices for food from snacks to lunch. We do not have a hostel, but we have a gym. Our college is especially known for sports, and our students have won many awards and medals. We do have a medical room for sick students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the college and the faculty .

content.Placements: 90 percent of are placed in our college. The highest package is about 6 Lacs per annum. The recruiting companies are many MNCs and TCS. Every student got the maximum number of internship opportunities in our c college. The roles offered are from the IT companies.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is not good; it should be improved and maintained well. There is Wi-Fi in our college but we are not allowed to use it. The library also needs to be improved because there are not enough books to read. The hostel's facilities are pretty good .

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: My 2 years of college life is very bad.

content.Placements: I already passed out, and my passed out year is 2020. Placements are very less, and the teaching is very bad as they teach like school teachers. I think only 10 companies visit here to offer placement opportunities. However, some of the students who attended placements got jobs, while remaining did not attend. Only low-level companies visit the campus.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, there is no hostel, and Wi-Fi was not provided. There is a very poor canteen, and the fee is high. There are very bad bathrooms, and they collect the fee every year to construct buildings. So, every student dislikes the college. There is a very poor library, and there is no medical facility.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: One of the best college in Visakhapatnam.

content.Placements: In our college special branch is MBA. The Students will Score very well in our college. highest salary 38000 and lowest 18000 was offered. Recruiting companies like Amazon, just daily & etc. hired the students. Package, 6lacs per annum was offered to our course. 74% students got in internship.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities in our college are labs, library, play ground etc. Best quality and best facilities in our hostel. Sports, games cultural activities are held regularly. Some other activities and events are done in our college. Quality was simply superb. Rooms will be clean.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the faculty members and their support.

content.Placements: The placement opportunities provided by the college were good, and there are many on-campus and off-campus drives held by the college. Many companies like Just dial, Indigo, etc. visit the campus for placements. The pay packages will also be good, and the students will be provided with n-number of opportunities to avail and put the student's turn to grab them.
content.Infrastructure: The campus has the well-maintained infrastructure and spacious classrooms. It has a library, seminar hall, computer lab, and a playground for sports. The rooms are ventilated which would help the students to study comfortably, and it also has a canteen which provides fresh and healthy food to its students. The college also allows an hour or two in a week for sports for the students to give refreshment from studies.

review_summary.college_name: KMCT College of Engineering Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Academics is everything. If you study, you will get everything you want.

content.Placements: There are no college placements nowadays. Some years ago, we had decent placements. It is better to search for a job outside college after graduation. The college is promising to make placements better and give more internship opportunities for students to make use of.
content.Infrastructure: Overall, the infrastructure is not bad. There is no free Wi-Fi. Lab facilities are not enough. Our college has a good library. There are decent hostels according to the fees. The hostel fee is cheap. There are shelves for storage. Ending machines are available in hostels. The curfew time is 6 PM for girls and 8 PM for boys.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: High frequency student communities, and good placement opportunities.

content.Placements: This college has average placements. The highest salary package offered this year is around 7 LPA. The average salary package is around 3 LPA. There are so many recruiters, mostly from startup companies. Top roles offered are assistant software engineer and trainees.
content.Infrastructure: College has average infrastructure. Labs here are not promising. Hostels have minimum facilities. The whole campus is enabled with Wi-Fi. The major advantage is college has a great library, which provides study materials, journals, etc. Canteen provides good food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Average infrastructure facilities but good curriculum and extra curriculum activities.

content.Placements: This college has average placements. In my batch, about 50% of students are placed in various companies in South India. The highest salary package offered this year is about 6 LPA. There are so many recruiters mostly from startups. Top roles offered are assistant software engineers and trainees.
content.Infrastructure: The college has an average infrastructure. Labs have all facilities. Hostels also have minimum facilities. The whole campus is enabled with Wi-Fi. The major advantage is college has a great library facility with full Wi-Fi. The canteen has good food availability. Games and sports are regularly conducted each year.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Less strength of students, but good placements and high frequency students communities.

content.Placements: Few students are having fewer back papers placed in companies under on-campus recruitment. And many students have many back papers placed in many companies under community-based off-campus recruitment. So students can easily get placed by choosing the opportunities provided by the college.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is like a hospital. But the facilities provided by the college are good. They provide Wi-Fi, labs, a better library, supporting staff, hostel facility, canteen, playground, annual sports, and games and there is a big national event called KARMA is the main attraction of the college. The canteen food is good and it's less cost.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The campus atmosphere is good for study.

content.Placements: I really don't know how many placements are offered. The highest placements are offered in MBA, and the lowest placements are offered in MCA. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Wipro, TCS etc. The top roles offered in my course are data analyst, programmer, developer, designer etc. Students also get government jobs.
content.Infrastructure: There are separate hostels for girls and boys. The classrooms, library and a canteen, are available. Labs are good. Wi-Fi is available. Lots of books are available for us to refer to. Two canteens are available. We can take college buses by paying 10 rupees.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Eco-friendly environments. I would surely recommend it to others.

content.Placements: 90% of students got placement by college to the great MNCs. You get internships in your last semester in MNC which chose you on the basis of your academics. In my course, we get government jobs, like PSPCL, electrical department, and many more which is very great.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very well as every department has different buildings and management. There are blocks from A-F and canteens are also available. Hostel rooms are well-maintained, rooms have peaceful atmosphere, and mess food is also very good and healthy.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied from the college fest, and placement. The hostel, campus, canteen is very good.

content.Placements: Out of 120 students, approximately 10–15 students were placed. The highest package was 6 LPA, the lowest was 2.2 LPA, and the average was around 3.2–3.4 LPA. Companies like Jio, Zscaler, Infosys, and Wipro participated in the placement drive. Only 10–15 students got placed. My roommate was placed in a local company in Mohali with a zero salary package. This was for B.Tech in CSE, Mechanical, Civil, and Electrical branches.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was very good, with the college spread across around 100 acres. It had a lush green campus, a cricket ground, volleyball court, badminton and tennis courts. The hostel quality was decent, and the food was awesome. Medical facilities, canteen, sports, library all basic things were present. Only the placement was not good.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Average college because placement and hostel facilities are not good.

content.Placements: 30 percent of students were placed in our course. In my presence, all packages—the highest, the lowest and the average—are the same and all are approximately 2 lacs per year. The top recruiting companies in our course are AMNS, SUBROS, MARUTI SUZUKI and sometimes MAHINDRA. 70 percent of our students got internships in our course.
content.Infrastructure: If we talk about facilities, there are not good facilities for students; wi-fi is available but only for teachers; classrooms are good; and we can also say the library is good. The quality of the facilities in our hostel was also not that good. The quality of food in hostels is that they used to serve boring food and if sometimes they served good food then they gave limited. There were hardly any facilities, like medical facilities or sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The faculty is satisfactory; placements are always there; and the infrastructure is also very good.

content.Placements: Actually, we all know that B.Tech. is a professional course, and everyone wants placement from the college. I can proudly tell you that our branch students got 100% placement. The top recruiting companies are Wipro, Microsoft, etc. The package varies here from INR 2 to INR 15 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The whole college is covered with Wi-Fi facilities. As there are computer centers, labs, and libraries, everything is fully furnished here. All types of books are present in the library. The rooms are ventilated properly. The hostel facility is also very good. The food served here is of good quality. The canteen is hygienic. The medical facilities are also available. There are many grounds, and many types of sports areas are available.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Shaheed Bhagat Singh State Technical Campus Review.

content.Placements: The placement cell was not good. The maximum students didn't get the placement from college. They will have to take the placement outside the college, and the computer labs are not so good, neither the fans and neither the projectors were working.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel doesn't look like a hostel and the infrastructure was not so good. The infrastructure of Ganga Bhawan and Beas Bhawan was so old and needs maintenance, but the college authority doesn't take any action about this. Neither the hostel camera was good and the security of the student's properties was also not good. Overall, there is no security in the hostel for boys.
