overview_faqs.question: Is MEC - Muthiammal Engineering College a known college/Institute?
overview_faqs.answer: MEC - Muthiammal Engineering College is a well-known institution for B.Tech, MBA/PGDM, MCA, M.E./M.Tech courses. These programs are delivered by highly experienced faculty. As per Shiksha verified reviews, MEC - Muthiammal Engineering College has a rating of 3.8 on the basis of reviews by students. Not just this, it has also been rated 3.7 on campuslife, 4 on placements, 3.8 on faculty and 3.5 on Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: Muthiammal Engineering College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Well-structured MBA program with good ROI and engaging campus life.

content.Placements: I'm part of the 2025 passing out batch of MBA. My experience throughout the 2 years is quite enriching, both academically and socially. All of the internships are good and provided more knowledge. A percentage of students got internships from our course, and the companies are all good.
content.Infrastructure: All Wi-Fi and labs are good and understandable. The hostel is good, and the food in the mess and canteen is great. Medical facilities, sports, and games are good, it is all okay.
content.Faculty: I chose MBA to enhance my managerial and strategic decision-making skills. The best part of the course is the case-based teaching methodology, experienced faculty members, and internship opportunities with reputed companies. The peer group is diverse, which adds to the learning experience.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Strong faculty and facilities, but room for placement improvement.

content.Placements: At Muthayammal Engineering College, around 85% of students got placed. The highest package offered is 10 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is 4.5 LPA. Top recruiters include TCS, Wipro, Infosys, and Zoho. Nearly 75% of students got internships in companies like HCL, CTS, and Tech Mahindra. Top roles offered are developer and analyst.
content.Infrastructure: Our department at Muthayammal Engineering College offers smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, modern labs with the latest systems, and a well-stocked digital library. Hostels are clean with 24/7 water and Wi-Fi. Mess food is decent and hygienic. Good medical care is available. Sports facilities are well-maintained for indoor and outdoor games.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I'm dissatisfied because of the faculty and the bad placement offers.

content.Placements: I think this college is not good at placement and the teaching is very bad. It does not train students for placement. They are offering a low package for students. All the local companies are visiting the college. The highest salary package that was offered to us was 3 LPA, and the lowest salary package was 1.2 LPA. Only a few get selected for placement.
content.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi when coming to labs in this college. In the labs, only a few systems are working. They have no experience as professors. The classrooms are very bad. There are no workers to serve the students. The mess is not bad. They don't care about students' medical facilities. They are not that supportive of sports and games. Our canteen is the worst. There is no Wi-Fi in the hostel. The bathroom in our hostel is very bad.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Our college is very good who want to study and gain some knowledge.

content.Placements: Around 85% of students are placed in the 2021-22 batch. The highest salary package offered is 10 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 1.8 LPA. Many students get internships. Regarding placements, this college is good for studying students. The top recruiting companies are Wipro, TCS, CTS, and many more.
content.Infrastructure: In this college, the infrastructure is good. The hostel is very for Andhra and Tamil students, it has separate food and hostel. This college is green and the campus is good with well-equipped furniture. For hostel students gym is also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Our college provides good infrastructure and teaching. Food served in the hostel is good.

content.Placements: About 90-95% of the students from our course got placed. The salary package offered ranges between 1-5 LPA. LNT is the top recruiting company that visited our college for placements. Almost 95% of the students from our course got an internship. Top roles like a supervisor, site engineer, designing engineers and surveyor are offered to the students.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is quite good. All the labs are efficient with maximum equipment for practice. Every classroom is spacious and comfortable for students. Facilities like Wi-Fi, spacious rooms, clean infrastructure and quality food are available in the hostel. Sport and games are given special priority here.

overview_faqs.question: Is it worth to consider Einstein College of Engineering as a good Institute?
overview_faqs.answer: Einstein College of Engineering is a reputed institute for B.Tech, MBA/PGDM, M.E./M.Tech. Students can opt these programs to pursue their career in Engineering, Business & Management Studies. Institute has trained & experienced faculty who deliver these programs. As per Shiksha verified reviews, Einstein College of Engineering has a rating of 3.5 on the basis of reviews by students. Not just this, it has also been rated 3.7 on campuslife, 3 on placements, 3.3 on faculty and 3.8 on Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: Einstein College of Engineering Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Einstein college is the best!

content.Placements: From the 3rd semester onwards, students get eligible for campus placements and the placement department also provides us with several trainings so that we can perform excellently in our placement session. Almost 90% of the students get placed in my batch. The one who got the highest salary package was around 34 lacs per annum and the average salary package was around 8 lacs per annum.
content.Infrastructure: Our college organizes many festivals and events to maintain a good bond between the students and the faculty members. The campus is not so big but has a beautiful infrastructure. The hostels are very close to the college, within walking distance. The canteen is also present in our college, which serves great-quality food. Wi-Fi is provided to us on a timely basis.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I would like libraries to have more books that improve knowledge.

content.Placements: At the end of the 2nd semester, we are eligible for placement drives, but for a job after the 3rd semester is complete, the college will grant permission to join the job and also have an opportunity for an off-campus drive. Around 15 to 18 companies visited our college, and around 75 to 80 percent of students got placement. Our courses have the highest package of INR 14 lacs, and our average course package is around INR 5 lacs. Some of the students start startups and join jobs.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel rooms are large; there are 4 students in a room, and four beds are given by the college for a room. The hostel was routinely cleaned, the toilets were cleaned daily, and the food in the mess was quite awesome. I am not a hosteller, but these things are informed by my friends. External Expenses: Rs. 2000–Rs. 4000

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with our college.

content.Placements: Our college provided good placements in 2017. Around 40% of students got placed in our college. The highest salary offered was Rs. 35,000 per month. The lowest salary offered was Rs. 12,000 per month. Top compahad not visited our college. Our college had not provided internships for our course.
content.Infrastructure: Our department had Auto CAD and field survey labs with all equipment. Each classroom used to accommodate 60 students. The library had many technical and non-technical related books and magazines. The hostel was very clean. Our college surroundings were cleaned daily by the housekeeping staff. The food served in the hostel was healthy and tasty.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: This college is the best in Tamil Nadu zone.

content.Placements: Placements were good in this college. Probably for every year achieving 90% of placements of that batch. The highest salary package offered was 5.5 LPA, and the average salary pacakge offered was 3.5 LPA. The lowest salary pacakge offered was 2 LPA. Top MNCs were TCS, CTS, Infosys, Broadcom, etc. Almost 60-70% of students got internships. The top roles offered were software developer, machine design, VLSI designer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was good. It has a highly equipped laboratory for each department. Thiruvalluvar library was the highlighted one. It has a separate huge building for the library. The classrooms were good and provide water facilities. The food served in the hostel was good.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2014
individual_reviews.title: Everything is good here. But sometimes we felt like we were still studying in a school.

content.Placements: Placements in our college are quite good. Some MNCs visited the campus, and our friends were placed in companies like HCL and Range etc. Around 50% to 60 % of the students were placed from the college. Many good companies visit the campus to hire the students of ECE and CSE departments when compared to mechanical and civil branches. It is a good college when compared to other colleges in Tirunelveli district.
content.Infrastructure: Our college had an infrastructure that we see in any other college. Labs and classrooms are quite good, neat and clean. We have a big open auditorium for cultural events. The college celebrates two events very grandly. One is freshers' day, and the other one is college day which is held on March 14. We have separate hostels for men and women. Food varieties offered are okay here. We have 50 buses for transport facilities. The bus facility is provided for students who live within 60 km distance from the college. All the labs were named with the names of famous scientists related to that subject.

review_summary.college_name: St. Paul Institute of Professional Studies Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Our college is good for everyone. So, please come and take admission.

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed in our course is 60% . The top recruiting company for your course is Tata consultancy serviceTCS big 4 like delight the highest average package at my college, which is 10 lakh per annum. The lowest average package is 3 lakh per annum.
content.Infrastructure: I think all things are well maintained. And all faculty are more possessive of their students . Our college has a big ground to play cricket, volleyball, and has a basketball court, badminton court, and table tennis court. The faculty’s help to maintain these facilities is very helpful to students.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: My insights on SPIPS journey.

content.Placements: 50 students pursuing BCA at SPIPS. Companies like TCS and Microsoft have offered placements to most of our top-scoring students, with salaries of 3 lacs per annum. Many students choose BCA because they want to build their careers in the IT field, such as web development, software engineering, and data analysis.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is top-notch. Each floor has a computer lab with at most 35 systems. There is a badminton arena with two courts. The library is the most peaceful place on campus, and it has a good selection of interesting books. The canteen provides hygienic food and drinks. The classrooms have smart boards, and innovative lectures are set up to make learning fun and easy.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: School-like discipline and strict management.

content.Placements: No one that I know has been offered campus placement from BCA but a few of my seniors for different courses were recruited from campus by companies such as TCS, which offers jobs even to 12th graders, so placements are below average. But the college provides some good internship opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Cleanliness is maintained at all times; even clean and safe changing room facilities are available for both boys and girls; there is overall good infrastructure; no hostel facility is available. No bus facility is provided, and once you enter the college premises, you cannot leave before the last lecture.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: A genuine review for others.

content.Placements: The average placements package offered is 200000 in this course. Many companies visited the campus for recruitments and students got good placements in local as well in good companies. The highest package offered was of 3.5 lacs and the top recruiters include ICICI and many others.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was quite good with a library and a good badminton court, a table tennis room and a big auditorium. The canteen is good. There are various computer labs and good classrooms having a good and peaceful environment across the college.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: The college has excellent faculty members.

content.Placements: Our college provides placements to around 40% of students every year. The highest package offered at our college was 14 LPA. The lowest package offered was 2 LPAs. The average package offered was 3–8 LPA. The top recruiters in our course were HDFC, IDBI, HCL, etc. The top roles offered were relationship manager, HR analyst, etc.
content.Infrastructure: At the institute, the infrastructure for our course was good. In terms of facility quality, it was also good. The college has a garden, Wi-Fi, sports fields, a library, labs, etc. on its campus. The college also provides hostel facilities for the students. In the hostel, the food was good to eat.
